t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two groups of Gnomes to choose from: Earth coloured and non-earth coloured. Earth colour examples: yellow, green, brown, orange. Non-earth colour examples: pink, blue, red, purple. The earth colour Gnomes tend to give more points, but this can change at any time during the round so experiment by choosing different colours at different times to see if the higher points have been allocated to the non-earth coloured Gnome.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes are split into two colour groups: earthy colours such as green, brown, yellow and orange and non-earthy colours such as blue, red, pink and purple. I generally found that the earthy colours gave the highest points the most often, however this changes at random throughout the game so it helps to experiment and see if the highest points have changed to a different gnome group. I found it useful to experiment when the x5 was on as if the gnome score was lower, this would then be multiplied by 5 so my score would still be quite good. Good luck.
